title: Asian Tofu with Crunchy Carrot, Asparagus, Avocado & Sesame Salad

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with soy sauce, oil, maple syrup, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the sauce.

Cut tofu planks in half, then cut each half into four triangles. Add to the bowl with the sauce and turn to coat. Transfer to a large baking dish and arrange in an even layer. (Wipe bowl clean and reserve for later use.)
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until tofu is golden and crispy, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place mayo, vinegar, sesame seeds, oil, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears crosswise into thin coins. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide tofu and salad between plates. Enjoy!
